newsitem.title: UK: Uzbekistan plans double gold output in five years.
newsitem.headline: Uzbekistan plans double gold output in five years.

text.p: The resource-rich Central Asian state of Uzbekistan plans to double its output of gold within five years, a senior banker said on Sunday.
The former Soviet republic produces some 60 tonnes of gold a year and is the world's seventh biggest producer.

"We are not happy with this position and we are expecting that within the next few years we will double gold production," Rustam Azimov, chairman of the National Bank for Foreign Economic Activity, said during a presentation at the annual meeting of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development.
"It will take a maximum of five years," he said.
Azimov said Uzbekistan had 39 approved gold deposits but extracted from only 12.
He said Uzbek authorities were in talks with several foreign producers about joint venture gold projects.
